hero.title: When the airspace closes, know exactly what to cancel.
hero.sub_main: fuses the flood of disruption signals — airspace closures, weather, geopolitics — into a single decision: the exact flights to cancel to protect your on-time performance.

why_now.title: The world is becoming harder to operate in.
why_now.sub: Conflict, geopolitics and drones now close airspace without warning — and the warning signs arrive as scattered, unreadable signals across Eurocontrol alerts, NOTAMs, TAFs and live tracks.

stats.cap: 2025 forecast cost of European airspace-related (ATFM) delay to airlines.
Growth in ATFM delay since 2015 — rising far faster than traffic.
Drone-related airport disturbances logged by Germany's DFS in 2025 — roughly three a day.
Net profit per passenger. One mishandled day erases the margin on tens of thousands of passengers.

why_now.sources: Sources: Eurocontrol (PRR 2024 + 2025 forecast) · IATA 2026 · DFS / Euronews 2025.

problem.title: One closure unravels the entire day.
problem.sub: A sector shuts at 06:00; by 18:32 the damage has compounded through the bank — and the window to respond is minutes.

cascade.title: Sector shuts
cascade.desc: 06:00–11:00 UTC, surfaced in a flood of raw alerts.

cascade.title: +98 min added
cascade.desc: Non-linear knock-on across the whole bank.

cascade.title: −8pp → 71%
cascade.desc: Expected day on-time performance falls off a cliff.

cascade.title: 3 misses · 4 at risk
cascade.desc: Curfew breaches and diversion-risk flights stack up.

cascade.title: Crews hit limits
cascade.desc: Duty-time limits bite; aircraft end up out of position.

cascade.title: Cost compounds
cascade.desc: The damage spills into tomorrow — and the day after.

problem.gap_before: today this is a manual judgment call. No one can reliably say

solution.title: Orville is the disruption intelligence platform.
solution.sub: It fuses every disruption signal into one tool — and tells you exactly what to do to protect your operation.

cards.title: See the day before it happens
cards.desc: Fuses Eurocontrol, Met Office and live signals into an airline-specific OTP forecast — with prediction intervals, not point guesses.

cards.title: Get the exact intervention
cards.desc: Returns the exact number and the specific flights to cancel to hold your OTP target — a ranked, ready-to-action list.

cards.title: Act with confidence
cards.desc: Shows the before / after counterfactual so you can defend the call — and brief the floor in one click.

solution.aside_tail: — NetLine/Ops, Movement Manager, AIMS, iFlight. Orville advises; your team decides and acts. No write-back, no automated cancellation.

how.title: Two inputs. No integration. Live in days.
how.sub: You don't connect Orville to your systems. You give it two things — it runs the rest.

steps.title: Two inputs
steps.desc: Your nominations list — the flights that matter most — and your OTP targets. That's the whole setup.

steps.title: Alert fires
steps.desc: An airspace closure fires. Orville picks it up automatically and reads the affected sectors and window.

steps.title: Seconds, not hours
steps.desc: It simulates the entire operation — every airline, every rotation — under the new airspace, in seconds.

steps.title: Ranked and ready
steps.desc: The exact number and the specific flights to cancel to hit your OTP targets — ranked and ready.

how.aside_tail: No deep integration with airline or airport systems. A pilot goes live in days, not quarters — and Orville simulates every carrier's operation, not just yours.

payoff.title: From melt-down to managed day.
payoff.sub: The same closure, two futures — quantified before you commit a single cancellation.
payoff.lever_tail: 8 targeted cancellations in a 4-hour window turn a melt-down into a managed day — and you see it before you commit.
